description: This Java source file defines the AmqpPublisherActor class, an Akka actor responsible for creating JMS MessageProducers and sending ExternalMessages as JMSMessages over AMQP protocol. It manages static and dynamic targets, handles producer creation, message sending, backoff, and resource cleanup.

classes.name: AmqpPublisherActor
classes.description: An Akka actor managing JMS MessageProducers for AMQP messaging, handling message dispatch, producer lifecycle, backoff logic, and error handling.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for actor instantiation with connection, session, and configuration.

methods.name: shouldPublishAcknowledgement
methods.description: Determines if an acknowledgement should be published based on its label.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Performs initialization tasks when the actor starts, like creating static producer targets.

methods.name: preEnhancement
methods.description: Defines message handlers for setup messages, such as producer status reports and start signals.

methods.name: handleProducerClosedStatusReport
methods.description: Handles scenarios where a producer is closed; triggers backoff and cleanup.

methods.name: handleStartProducer
methods.description: Initializes or reinitializes static producer targets.

methods.name: createStaticTargetProducers
methods.description: Creates message producers for static target destinations.

methods.name: toPublishTarget
methods.description: Converts an address string into an AmqpTarget.

methods.name: createTargetProducer
methods.description: Creates and stores a MessageProducer for a specific destination.

methods.name: findByValue
methods.description: Utility function to find map entries by MessageProducer value.

methods.name: backOff
methods.description: Enters backoff mode and triggers backoff actor to restart producer creation.

methods.name: postEnhancement
methods.description: Post-initialization extension point, currently no-op.

methods.name: publishMessage
methods.description: Public method to asynchronously publish a message, respects backoff mode.

methods.name: newContext
methods.description: Creates a new message context for publishing, with or without a producer.

methods.name: newContextWithProducer
methods.description: Creates message context when a producer is available, handling JMS message creation and callback.

methods.name: newContextWithoutProducer
methods.description: Creates a failure context when no producer is available.

methods.name: handleQueueOfferResult
methods.description: Handles the result of offering a message to the source queue.

methods.name: toAcknowledgement
methods.description: Converts a Signal into an Acknowledgement, including header and entity ID info.

methods.name: getMessageSendingException
methods.description: Wraps exceptions into MessageSendingFailedException with diagnostic info.

methods.name: getBackOffModeError
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the producer is in backoff mode.

methods.name: toJmsMessage
methods.description: Converts an ExternalMessage into a JMS Message, setting properties and payload.

methods.name: getProducer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a MessageProducer for a destination.

methods.name: tryToCreateProducer
methods.description: Attempts to create a producer for a destination, handling JMSException.

methods.name: createProducer
methods.description: Creates a new MessageProducer for a destination.

methods.name: maintainReplyToMap
methods.description: Maintains cache size for dynamic targets by removing oldest producers.

methods.name: closeCachedProducer
methods.description: Closes and removes a cached MessageProducer.

methods.name: jmsExceptionToString
methods.description: Converts a JMSException to string for logging.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Cleans up resources, stopping the actor, and closing producers.
